config.label: Names this agent's tab ownership
config.description: Names this agent's tab ownership. Two agents with different labels never see each other's owned tabs. Defaults to "default".

config.label: The Arc space new tabs open into, when a space with that name exists
config.description: The Arc space new tabs open into, when a space with that name exists. Arc will not let a script create a space, so make it by hand. Defaults to "Agent".

config.label: Directory where per-session tab ownership is recorded, so a restarted agent can clean up the tabs its previous run left behind
config.description: Directory where per-session tab ownership is recorded, so a restarted agent can clean up the tabs its previous run left behind. Defaults to ~/Library/Application Support/arc-control-mcp.
